rules: Bounded public GET only. Saved positive/negative search, exact lookup and variant evidence plus actual default per_page=20/8s controller search with positive USD price and approved image. US market inference is marked; no all-address shipping, merchant trust, affiliate or card eligibility is granted. COMPLETE describes bounded source work; diagnostics.truncated is independent. Full local raw is retained by hash; admitted raw samples are versioned separately.
